envelope.description: Prepare and approve current activation evidence

body.title: Prepare and approve current activation evidence
body.summary: Inventory existing canonical governance records; reuse existing evaluation/readiness mechanisms and prepare exact mode probes, independent oracle/evaluation, readiness and predecessor reconciliation references. Obtain required explicit approvals rather than treating preparation or system actors as independent adjudication.
acceptanceChecks: Current mode-specific canonical probe records reference actual validated candidates and exact installed source/profile/catalog/policy pins.
Independent oracle adjudication is by a real person with current canonical approval; actual evaluation preserves every required defect/control/coverage row and meets existing criteria.
Readiness and predecessor reconciliation records are concrete, current, approved and accepted by unchanged normal admission. No signatures or automatic/fake approvals.
If evidence/approval is pending or evaluation fails, name the specific record/check and keep t5 pending/failed; do not infer readiness from config or fixtures.

tests.name: Current canonical qualification independent evaluation readiness and reconciliation pass normal production admission
